roundtrip.code:
| base result build export encode reports |
base := '/opt/git/BenjaVisionPro/catalyst-workspace/Magritte/magritte-cpp/conformance/'.
result := [ CCNativeMcpLease forRunningServers during: [
build := [ :j | | cls | cls := j at: 'class'.
 cls = 'MADictionaryAccessor' ifTrue: [ MADictionaryAccessor key: (j at: 'key') asSymbol ] ifFalse: [
 cls = 'MACompositeAccessor' ifTrue: [ (MACompositeAccessor on: (build value: (j at: 'steps') second) accessor: (build value: (j at: 'steps') first)) kind: (((j at: 'kind') at: 'type') = 'nil' ifTrue: [ nil ] ifFalse: [ Smalltalk globals at: ((j at: 'kind') at: 'value') asSymbol ]); yourself ] ifFalse: [
 cls = 'MAChainAccessor' ifTrue: [ MAChainAccessor accessors: ((j at: 'steps') collect: build) ] ifFalse: [
 cls = 'MADelegatorAccessor' ifTrue: [ MADelegatorAccessor on: (build value: (j at: 'next')) ] ifFalse: [ self error: 'Unsupported roundtrip accessor' ] ] ] ] ].
export := [ :a | | cls | cls := a class name asString.
 cls = 'MADictionaryAccessor' ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'class' -> cls. 'key' -> a key asString } ] ifFalse: [
 cls = 'MACompositeAccessor' ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'class' -> cls. 'kind' -> (a kind ifNil: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'nil' } ] ifNotNil: [ :k | Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'class'. 'value' -> k name asString } ]). 'steps' -> { export value: a accessor. export value: a next } } ] ifFalse: [
 cls = 'MAChainAccessor' ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'class' -> cls. 'steps' -> { export value: a accessor. export value: a next } } ] ifFalse: [
 Dictionary newFrom: { 'class' -> cls. 'next' -> (export value: a next) } ] ] ] ].
encode := [ :v | v class = MACompositeConflict ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'conflict'. 'kind' -> (v kind ifNotNil: [ :k | k name asString ]). 'string' -> v string } ] ifFalse: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'string'. 'value' -> v } ] ].
reports := #('cpp' 'swift') collect: [ :port | | input accessors cases |
 input := NeoJSONReader fromString: ('/private/tmp/magritte-', port, '-composite-native.json') asFileReference contents.
 accessors := (input at: 'accessors') collect: build.
 cases := accessors collect: [ :a | | people model before after canRead canWrite target |
 people := { Dictionary newFrom: { #name -> 'a'. #nested -> (Dictionary newFrom: { #name -> 'a' }) }. Dictionary newFrom: { #name -> 'b'. #nested -> (Dictionary newFrom: { #name -> 'b' }) } }.
 model := Dictionary newFrom: { #people -> people }.
 canRead := a canRead: model. canWrite := a canWrite: model. before := a read: model. a write: 'all' to: model. after := a read: model.
 Dictionary newFrom: { 'canRead' -> canRead. 'canWrite' -> canWrite. 'before' -> (encode value: before). 'after' -> (encode value: after). 'name' -> a name asString. 'label' -> (a defaultLabelFor: MAStringDescription new) } ].
 Dictionary newFrom: { 'port' -> port. 'accessors' -> (accessors collect: export). 'cases' -> cases } ].
reports
] ] ensure: [ (base, 'composite-roundtrip-mcp-gate.json') asFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :s | s truncate; nextPutAll: '{"complete":true,"nativeResources":false}' ] ].
(base, 'composite-roundtrip-reference.json') asFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :s | s truncate; nextPutAll: (NeoJSONWriter toStringPretty: result) ].
result collect: [ :r | { r at: 'port'. (r at: 'cases') size } ]
